description.value: Soi Ram is a Thai restaurant located in Tsawwassen, BC, serving the Delta Street corridor. As a sit-down Thai restaurant, it would offer a warm meal stop for cyclists exploring the South Delta area near the Tsawwassen ferry terminal and the surrounding flat farmland cycling routes.
